extraction.name: NeedleBench
extraction.description: A synthetic bilingual long-context benchmark for evaluating LLM retrieval and reasoning across information-sparse and information-dense tasks, including Single-Needle Retrieval, Multi-Needle Retrieval, Multi-Needle Reasoning, and the Ancestral Trace Challenge (ATC).
extraction.creator: Mo Li; Songyang Zhang; Taolin Zhang; Haodong Duan; Yunxin Liu; Kai Chen
extraction.rai:dataCollection: NeedleBench is a synthetic framework. Information-sparse tasks use synthetic needles inserted into filler passages from Paul Graham Essays (English) and ChineseDomainModelingEval (Chinese). Information-dense ATC instances are generated algorithmically from randomized names, relationship terms, templates, and shuffled statements.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Experiments; Document analysis; Manual Human Curator; Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Paul Graham Essays dataset for English filler; ChineseDomainModelingEval dataset for Chinese filler; synthetic fabricated facts and synthetic family-relationship statements generated for needles and ATC.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Needles are inserted at varying depths/positions into long contexts; ATC statements are shuffled to eliminate positional bias; synthetic tasks are constructed to match target lengths and reasoning complexity; some outputs are post-processed to extract content inside \boxed{...} for evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Contexts are extended to target token lengths with a buffer to avoid instruction truncation; token lengths are measured with the GPT-4 tokenizer; evaluation uses greedy decoding with temperature 0 unless otherwise specified.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For ATC, ground-truth answers are computed algorithmically from the constructed family structure. The paper also reports manual annotation of approximately 10% of observed ATC errors to categorize failure modes.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: ATC evaluation uses exact match and weighted averages across needle counts; ENL-50 is reported as the maximum needle count with at least 50% accuracy. For error analysis, approximately 10% of observed ATC errors were manually annotated and categorized into under-thinking, partial understanding, instruction following, repetitive output, hallucination, and other errors.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Exact match scoring; keyword-aware Exact Match variant; \boxed{...} post-processing; GPT-4 tokenizer; LMDeploy; vLLM; OpenCompass.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: All codes and resources are publicly available at OpenCompass; reproducible scripts, code, and datasets will be made available upon publication. No explicit versioning, update schedule, or deprecation policy is stated.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Synthetic names and family relationships are used in ATC; the benchmark also includes bilingual language settings (English and Chinese). No real personal sensitive information is reported as collected.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark is intended to improve understanding and evaluation of long-context retrieval and reasoning in LLMs, with implications for real-world applications such as legal document retrieval, academic research, and business intelligence.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The paper notes that real-world long-context benchmarks may be affected by pretraining contamination and memorization; it also reports a performance gap between English and Chinese across most models.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: NeedleBench is synthetic and may not fully reflect the complexity of real-world tasks. Information-sparse retrieval is easier for many models, while information-dense tasks remain challenging; results may be affected by tokenizer differences and instruction truncation if not buffered.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation/benchmarking of LLMs for retrieval and reasoning in long-context settings; testing across context lengths; assessing training, validation, and model comparison performance on bilingual long-context tasks.
